reason: Two fixes to the generated template, both found while landing wawagardenbar-app#925: (1) Process-group reaping bug in the 'Start dev server' / 'Stop dev server' steps: `npm run dev &` is backgrounded without `set -m`, so the job isn't in its own process group, and the stop step's plain `kill "$PID"` only ever signals that one tracked PID. When `npm run dev` is a wrapper spawning `next dev` as a child, the wrapper exits on SIGTERM but the real server process is never signaled -- it's orphaned and accumulates across job runs until the self-hosted runner's memory cap is hit (this caused a real week-long crash/restart loop on this runner, Oct 9-16 2026). Fixed with `set -m` on start, process-group kill (`kill -TERM -- "-$PID"`) with plain-kill and `pkill -9 -P` fallbacks on stop. (2) STATUS-capture bug in the 'E2E Regression Tests' step's hook-invocation + inline fallback branches: GitHub Actions' default `run:` shell already has `-e` set before the step's own `set -uo pipefail` runs (`set` doesn't clear a flag it doesn't mention), so `cmd; STATUS=$?` loses the exit code -- a failing command (including `bash e2e/ci-reliability/regression-run.sh`) aborts the script before `STATUS=$?` is reached, skipping the outcome/completed_at/exit_code metadata merge entirely (confirmed empirically: two real sharded runs both landed with `e2e-regression-metadata.json` stuck at `outcome: "running"` despite the job correctly reporting failed). Fixed with `cmd || STATUS=$?` throughout, predeclaring `STATUS=0`. Fix (1) is scoped to the template's own two server steps (used by the critical/scoped-dispatch path, and before e2e/ci-reliability/regression-run.sh's sharded path takes over, if present); fix (2) is scoped to the 'E2E Regression Tests' step. Both are narrow immediate patches; the durable fix belongs in DevAudit-Installer's cli/src/update/ci-templates.ts -- tracked upstream at metasession-dev/DevAudit-Installer#1025 (fix 1) and metasession-dev/DevAudit-Installer#1029 (fix 2), drop this patch once both ship.
